384.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.
384.effect: User swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat modifiers modifiers with the target.

385.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.
385.effect: User swaps its Defense and Special Defense modifiers with the target.

386.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
386.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power starts at 60 and is increased by 20 for every stage any of the target’s stats has been raised, capping at 200. Accuracy and evasion modifiers do not increase this move’s power.

387.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.
387.effect: Inflicts regular damage. This move can only be used if each of the user’s other moves has been used at least once since the user entered the field. If this is the user’s only move, this move will fail.

388.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.
388.effect:
Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.

If the target’s ability is Truant or Multitype, this move will fail.

389.description: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
389.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target has not selected a damaging move this turn, or if the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

This move is not affected by Iron Fist.

390.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
390.effect:
Scatters poisoned spikes around the opposing field, which poison opposing Pokémon that enter the field. A second layer of these spikes may be laid down, in which case Pokémon will be badly poisoned instead. Pokémon immune to either Ground moves or being poisoned are immune to this effect. Pokémon otherwise immune to Ground moves are affected during Gravity.

If a Poison Pokémon not immune to Ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed.

Rapid Spin will remove this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog will remove this effect from its target’s side of the field.

This move does not trigger Synchronize, unless the Pokémon with Synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as Roar.

Pokémon entering the field due to Baton Pass are not affected by this effect.

391.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.
391.effect: User swaps its stat modifiers with the target.

392.description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.
392.effect:
Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP at the end of each turn. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

393.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
393.effect:
For five turns, the user is immune to Ground moves.

If the user is under the effect of Ingrain or has Levitate, this move will fail.

This effect is temporarily disabled by and cannot be used during Gravity.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

394.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot and may leave the target with a burn.
394.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

395.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
395.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

396.description: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.
396.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

397.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user's Speed stat.
397.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

398.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.
398.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

399.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.
399.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

400.description: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
400.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

401.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

402.description: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

403.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.
403.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

404.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.

405.description: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
405.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

406.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

407.description: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.
407.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

408.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

409.description: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
409.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

410.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

411.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
411.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

412.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
412.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

413.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.
413.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

414.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
414.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

415.description: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.
415.effect:
User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail.

If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail.

If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

416.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.
416.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

417.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
417.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

418.description: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

419.description: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.
419.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power.

Pain Split does not count as damaging the user.

420.description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

421.description: The user attacks by slashing the target with a sharp claw made from shadows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
421.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

422.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.
422.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

423.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.
423.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

424.description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.
424.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

425.description: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

426.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
426.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

427.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

428.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.
428.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

429.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
429.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

430.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
430.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

431.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
431.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

432.description: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.
432.effect:
Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage. Clears away fog. Removes the effects of Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Safeguard, Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the target’s side of the field.

If the target is protected by Mist, it will prevent the evasion change, then be removed by this move.

433.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
433.effect:
For five turns (including this one), slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon. Move priority is not affected. Using this move when its effect is already active will end the effect.

Pokémon holding Full Incense, Lagging Tail, or Quick Claw and Pokémon with Stall ignore this effect.

434.description: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
434.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

435.description: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.
435.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

436.description: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.
436.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

437.description: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
437.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

438.description: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.

439.description: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. The user can't move on the next turn.
439.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

440.description: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
440.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

441.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.
441.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

442.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.
442.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

443.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
443.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

444.description: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
444.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

445.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
445.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail.

446.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
446.effect:
Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP. This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to Rock moves.

Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field.

447.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
447.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120.

Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120
